items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a rational function on a locally Noetherian integral algebraic space and a prime divisor meeting the schematic locus, the order of vanishing defined in the chapter agrees with the classical order of vanishing for schemes (statement lines 876-884). The proof (proof lines 886-902) reduces to an integral Noetherian scheme, identifies the henselian local ring as a henselization, restates the assertion as an equality of lengths of quotients, and concludes by the invariance of length under a flat local extension. H2: a three-step reduction with three inputs, written out in full.
